title: v18 upgrade drops stored comment reactions (9963322fe8 does not migrate sys_comment.reactions) — under the maintainer's rule an upgrade keeps data
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). Source: the cloud upgrade rehearsal objectstack-ai/cloud#2867 `6147243232` (item I9), measured on a tenant kernel at `01a3421f42`. **It affects cloud's v18 upgrade (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so it is filed `priority:p1`, `target:v18`.**

## What happens

- **Data is lost:** a comment with reactions stored at v17 reads `reactions: null` at v18, and the column is orphaned (`[schema-drift]`).
- **This is deliberate:** commit `9963322fe8` says "stored reactions are not migrated".

## Why it is filed

The maintainer's rule for upgrades, 2026-10-13 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2843 `6145481762`): 「我没有要求清库，这个肯定不行啊，以后不可能每次升级都清库啊」. An upgrade keeps existing data. Reactions are user data that a v18 upgrade silently drops.

## Ask

- A conversion of stored `sys_comment.reactions` into v18's reaction storage, in the v18 upgrade (the ceremony or a stored-row replay).
- Or bring "accepted loss" to the maintainer explicitly. The seat does not decide that it is acceptable.
